extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders (industry, NGOs, researchers, public authorities and other interested parties) preparing or submitting input to ECHA consultations on EU chemicals regulation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and categories for submitting feedback and scientific information to ECHA public consultations across EU chemicals legislation (REACH, CLP, BPR, CAD/CMRD, POPs, etc.). Covers the types of consultations, procedural metadata (start date/deadline) and available support resources to prepare submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: ECHA organises consultations to get feedback from all interested parties and to gather the widest possible range of scientific information for the regulatory processes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should provide relevant feedback and scientific information. The aim is wide stakeholder input to inform regulatory decision-making; therefore contributions should be evidence-based and targeted to the regulatory questions under consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Substances of very high concern identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Substances of very high concern identification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations under this category seek information relevant to identifying SVHCs (e.g., hazard, exposure, uses, alternatives). Respondents should provide evidence and data addressing the criteria for SVHC identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Draft recommendation for inclusion in the Authorisation List and consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft recommendation for inclusion in the Authorisation List and consultation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultation responses should address the draft recommendation, provide scientific or socio‑economic evidence, and comment on whether the substance should be included in the Authorisation List.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Applications for authorisation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders may comment on applications for authorisation by providing technical, exposure or socio‑economic information relevant to the application and its assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Submitted restrictions under consideration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations on restriction proposals invite evidence on risks, socio‑economic impacts, and possible risk management options. Submissions should address the proposed restriction's justification, scope, and potential impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Current calls for comments and evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Current calls for comments and evidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These calls request data and scientific comments relevant to ongoing regulatory assessments. Respondents should supply primary data, study reports, or reasoned arguments to inform the assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: REACH: Current Testing Proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations on testing proposals seek stakeholder input on proposed testing needs and methods. Comments should address scientific necessity, test design, and possible alternative methods or waivers.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLP: Harmonised classification and labelling (CLH) proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations on CLH proposals invite evidence to support or contest proposed hazard classifications and labelling. Submissions should provide robust data on intrinsic hazards and, where relevant, human or environmental exposure information.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLP: Harmonised classification and labelling targeted consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: Harmonised classification and labelling targeted consultations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted consultations focus on specific aspects or stakeholders for a CLH proposal. Respondents should address the targeted questions and supply evidence requested in the consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLP: Consultations on ECHA Executive Director’s requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Consultations on ECHA Executive Director’s requests
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These consultations stem from Executive Director requests; inputs should respond specifically to the questions posed by the Director and provide relevant evidence or arguments.

rubrics_metrics.name: BPR: Potential candidates for substitution and derogations conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential candidates for substitution and on derogations conditions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations under BPR seek input on whether active substances are candidates for substitution or on conditions for derogations. Submissions should provide information on alternatives, risk–benefit considerations and conditions justifying derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CAD/CMRD: Consultations - Occupational Exposure Limits (OEL) proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OEL consultations request scientific and technical evidence on health-based limits and exposure assessments. Respondents should submit toxicological, epidemiological, or occupational exposure data relevant to setting OELs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CAD/CMRD: Calls for comments and evidence (OEL)
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls for comments and evidence: Occupational Exposure Limits
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These calls solicit broader evidence and comments on OEL-related assessments. Contributions should be data-driven and include study details, exposure scenarios, and any relevant uncertainty considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural requirement: start date and deadline for consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: Each consultation entry lists a start date and a deadline (e.g., Start date: 26/03/2026; Deadline: 25/05/2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders must submit comments and evidence within the specified consultation timeframe. Late submissions may not be considered; plan data collection and review activities to meet deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support resources and templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Support section provides tools and practical guidance to companies which have responsibilities under the EU chemicals legislation (Guidance on REACH, Formats and templates, Q&As, Webinars, Helpdesks, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing submissions, use ECHA guidance documents, formats and templates, Q&As and helpdesks to ensure completeness and correct formatting. Follow the specific guidance relevant to the regulation (REACH, CLP, BPR, CAD/CMRD) and the consultation type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ECHA data sources when preparing input
rubrics_metrics.description: This site provides unique sources of information on chemicals (Registered substances, C&L inventory, Candidate List, Authorisation List, Registry of restriction/SVHC intentions, PACT, CoRAP, SCIP, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respondents should consult and cite relevant ECHA inventories and databases to support comments (e.g., registered uses, classification entries, dossier evaluation status). Using these sources strengthens the evidential basis of submissions.
